text:
The folder audit is done and committed in `worktree/ai-folder-audit` (commits `92ed976a1` and `26ac3ab24`), ready for your review and merge.

- **Audit doc:** [ai-folder-audit.md](/framework/ai/doc/ai-folder-audit.md) has one row per top-level entry in `ai/`, most important first, with its writer, reader and verdict. It is linked from `ai/doc/readme.md`. Verdicts: 39 keep, 3 store, 8 module, 4 aside (6 files).
- **Aside moves:** six stale files went to `ai/archive/aside-2026-10-20/` with `git mv`, nothing deleted: `cand.txt`, `handoff2.md`, `handoff2-owner-words.md`, `heartbeat.jsonl`, `antigravity-usage.json` and `.jsonl`.
- **Census:** `census.mjs` prints JSON; the output is in `census.json`.
- **Old-session move:** `move-old-sessions.mjs` is dry-run only and `--apply` was not run. The manifest has 1 folder to move and 1 skipped as live (today's `ai/2026/10/20/`).

Decisions to check:
- The table covers top-level entries only, not the roughly 480 one-level-down files. The census has those.
- `board.jsonl` is marked keep, though its readme calls it retired; it was written 10-12, so it needs re-checking after 10-26.

Loose ends:
- `Servex/cards/readme.md` and `ai/doc/readme-before-2026-10-19.md` still link `handoff2.md`, which now 404s. My fence covered only the move, so I left them.
- `ai/tasks/` (252 legacy folders) and the old date folders still need the one-tree mover.

The session log is in the main tree and has the landing line. The `M` on the parent's `system-architect/session.jsonl` in the worktree was already there; I did not touch it.

✅ The rename is done and committed on `worktree/ai-index-rename`, but I haven't merged it. The merge dry-run refused because the branch has no review yet.

- **Tests:** the AIIndex, TaskState and Day tests pass. `node Server/AIIndex.mjs` wrote `ai/index.json` (check.ok true) and one `ai/index.jsonl` line.
- **Names:** `State` is now `AIIndex.mjs`, `state.json` is `index.json`, and `tasks/state.jsonl` is `ai/index.jsonl`. `Server/doc/ai-index.md` opens with the plain paragraph you asked for.
- **Readers and docs:** every reader and the readme links are updated. The new files are in `.gitignore`.
- **Screenshot:** `/framework/ai/` loads on the worktree at 1200 wide, but the worktree has no session data, so it only shows "No session index for this day." The screenshot is at `C:\Users\mike\AppData\Local\Temp\ask-shot-1792531662859.png`.
- **Stubs and wrapper:** `Server/State.mjs` and `Server/doc/state.md` are stubs that point to the new names until 2026-10-27. `TaskState.mjs` stays as the old wrapper class, not a 3-line alias, because its test uses that class; Servex now starts `AIIndex.mjs --watch` directly.
- **After merge:** restart Servex so `TaskLoop` spawns the new watcher. The old `state.json` and `state.jsonl` then go stale and can be deleted.
- **Left alone:**
  - The `Task.js` comments still cite `Server/doc/state.md`, since `core/Task/` was off-limits; the stub keeps those links working.
  - I kept the class names `DashState` and `TaskStateLog`.

The decision and log are in the task's `session.jsonl`.

I rewrote the `core/Session` readme and added the matching decisions to its `doc/architecture.md`. Both are committed in the worktree as `152a01cd1`, ready for you to merge. This was docs only, so I ran no code and no tests, and I checked every claim in the readme by reading `Session.js`, `Day.js` and `Session.test.mjs`.

The readme is about 45 lines. It has one sentence on what a `Session` is, then the class snapshot as code. That covers each class with its properties, API, callers, and how it loads. After that come the three rules.

- **Rule 1** (a session has tasks): built, as `session.tasks`.
- **Rule 2** (completion computed from tasks): built. With no tasks it reads 0, and nothing marks the session itself finished.
- **Rule 3** (never complete with a loose end): not built yet. No code refuses a close. The readme links it to step 5 of the plan in `sessions-and-tasks.md`.

I wrote `RefineSession` as planned rather than built, because no such class exists yet.

`doc/architecture.md` now has two new sections:
- **Session is an Item with tasks:** it links your dictation sections 9 and 11.
- **Not built yet:** it records the loose-end guard.

I logged the landing and the commit in my own `session.jsonl`.
